subcommands.description: Creates a rescore execution plan. A rescore execution plan is an Amazon Kendra Intelligent Ranking resource used for provisioning the Rescore API. You set the number of capacity units that you require for Amazon Kendra Intelligent Ranking to rescore or re-rank a search service's results. For an example of using the CreateRescoreExecutionPlan API, including using the Python and Java SDKs, see Semantically ranking a search service's results

options.name: --capacity-units
